description: This file defines the LogNode interface used for logging purposes within an Android development project. It specifies a method for outputting log data, supporting chained logging implementations.

classes.name: LogNode
classes.description: An interface to implement a chainable logging node that can output log data to various targets, with a method to log messages along with optional Throwable information.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Method to output a log message with a specified priority, tag, message, and optional Throwable.
